business_context.goal: Enable external stakeholders to approve forms and retain history if they join.
business_context.value_proposition: Seamless transition from external stakeholder to platform user with preserved audit trail.
business_context.risk: Shadow user data management (GDPR/Privacy). Mitigation: Clear data retention policies.

data_model.fields: TokenID, FormID, UserID (FK), Token, ExpiresAt, IsUsed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Auto-create 'EXTERNAL' user for new email addresses
Reuse existing 'EXTERNAL' user for repeated requests
Retain 'UserID' during upgrade to preserve history
Secure token logic linked to UserID
